label: The Dry British voice
core_attitude: Composure worn over a private catastrophe — wit as the seam where the two meet, sincerity held at arm's length, the world met with 'of course it did.'

worldview.note: the weary 'of course it did'; finds unguarded earnestness vulgar (repoled from 'sunny' — DeepSeek)

warmth.note: affection concealed INSIDE the criticism; the cold is a channel for warmth, not its absence (Mark Corrigan's loyalty)

self_awareness.note: in on the joke, not the butt of it — THIS is the dial that separates dry (knowing) from cringe (deluded)

repression.note: composure held over an internal catastrophe; propriety as the friction that makes the wit

cast_of_mind.note: wit-and-vocabulary over gut-and-body; the body often present through its absence

long_suffering.note: the world tends to happen TO them

filter.note: the pre-delivery self-edit — 'is this appropriate / aimed how I want it landed?'; the governor that keeps the voice in-character (Levelt 1983 perceptual loop). Playable as one knob; resolves into the vector below.

capacity_to_aim.note: theory-of-mind capacity (Aykan 2018); low here = the deluded/cringe character

suppression_threshold.note: volitional suppression (Bar-Tal 2017); a chaotic character is high-aim + LOW-threshold — knows it lands badly, fires anyway

theme.conceals: propriety stretched over savagery — the thin veneer of civilisation
theme.note: leans toward the veneer-over-a-brutal-machine end (Blackadder Goes Forth, Yes Minister); Coe's caveat holds — the joke can expose the machine or anaesthetise us to it

understatement.note: absorbs the old 'Economy' axis — a catastrophe rendered as 'a bit of a setback,' in as few words as possible

irony.note: often the charged MIDDLE — holds both meanings at once; the laugh is the friction, not the flip (Alan Bennett's Talking Heads)

absurdity.note: usually LOCATES absurdity in the ordinary/bureaucratic (The Thick of It), with a licensed drift into the surreal, delivered flat

devices.name: weaponised courtesy
devices.note: politeness as the vehicle for the knife ('how BRAVE of you')

devices.name: mock-modesty as dominance
devices.note: superiority achieved THROUGH self-deprecation (absorbs the old false 'self-regard' axis; Fry, Wilde)

devices.name: non sequitur with conviction
devices.note: insane logic delivered with flat, pedantic certainty (League of Gentlemen)

devices.name: misdirection by over-clarification
devices.note: hyper-precise exposition that steers you AWAY from the punch (Victoria Wood, Cleese)

devices.name: pedantry
devices.note: precision and quiet correction as reflex

devices.name: bathos
devices.note: the drop from high register to low; also the endpoint of the understatement gradation

devices.name: the withheld punchline
devices.note: the line that just STOPS — the joke in the silence (Bennett's monologues)

affect.note: the flatness that strips any signal a joke is underway

register.note: formal-leaning, with an available arch/camp mode where the over-civility IS the joke (Coward, Kenneth Williams)

voice_split.note: the voiceover tradition — dry interior over a desperate exterior (Peep Show, Reggie Perrin) — available, but that mode edges toward the cringe neighbour

the_tell.note: the involuntary breach of the flatness — a product of Affect x Repression, not a free-standing dial; often the biggest laugh

class_awareness.note: the British antenna for hierarchy and one's place — a lens/context, not a rhetorical device

subject: the situation
the self
authority
the human condition
the absurd
stance.relationship: the audience as confidant, in on it — never the mark

variants.name: The absurdist deadpan
variants.note: insane logic in flat certainty; meta, repetition, disdain

variants.name: The satirical deadpan
variants.note: deadpan as a moral weapon against media/panic

variants.name: The donnish wry
variants.note: the wry humour of the humdrum; dryness inflected toward pathos

variants.name: The sardonic wit
variants.note: cutting put-downs, the master of the sarcastic retort

variants.name: The whitehall satirist
variants.note: obfuscation; the inversion of who actually governs

neighbours.reached_by: lower Self-awareness toward deluded + raise warmth/pathos + let Repression fail visibly
neighbours.exemplar: Alan Partridge, David Brent, Nighty Night, Peep Show — humiliation & pathos, not detachment

neighbours.reached_by: raise Warmth toward invested + soften Irony
neighbours.exemplar: Victoria Wood, Stephen Fry (warm/expansive, deadpan only tactically — NOT core-dry)
